Scene heading: 1、INT. LIGHTHOUSE - NIGHT.

"""

INT. LIGHTHOUSE WATCH ROOM - NIGHT

A powerful beam rotates in the lantern room above. Below, in the watch room, MARCUS CALLOWAY (50s, weathered face, salt-and-pepper beard) moves between instrument panels. Each step reveals a pronounced limp -- his RIGHT LEG drags with a soft scrape while his left lands firmly.

FADE TO BLACK.
